top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Listed (26 TAC §HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - No)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Regular care is being provided to 2 unrelated children.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A report was not made to Child Care Regulation for an incident that potentially posed a risk to children.

top_violation_types.title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff stated that the permit holder is aware of the physical state that the classroom walls and floors are in. They stated that they are no longer accredited as a result and that work orders have been put in, but no repairs have been completed.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room (26 TAC §746.2805(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver locked children in the bathroom and turned the lights off.

top_violation_types.title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Director did not ensure that  employees complied with the minimum standards in the infant room on multiple  occasions.
